title: Building Out the World
body:
Working on the spaces between fights in The Hollow Signal.

This pass is about keeping the world coherent across three very different areas: dense relay halls, open Hushfall basins, and the exposed signal wastes. The recurring machinery, wiring, and warm relay lamps are doing most of that work.

I also put the current playable cast together in a character sheet to check how their silhouettes and colors sit against the environments.

![A dark switch hall lined with cabinets, insulators, teal repair wire, and one warm relay lamp.](../media/the-hollow-signal-2026-07-31-building-out-the-world/dreaming-relayworks.png)

![A vast Hushfall basin where a broken relay wheel lies half buried beneath a violet sky.](../media/the-hollow-signal-2026-07-31-building-out-the-world/hushfall-basin.png)

![Broken pylons and relay machinery leaning across the signal wastes at dusk.](../media/the-hollow-signal-2026-07-31-building-out-the-world/signal-wastes.png)

![A character sheet for Brother Ash, Ilex, Orin Vale, Tamsin Coil, Nyra Quell, and Sable Nox.](../media/the-hollow-signal-2026-07-31-building-out-the-world/character-sheet.png)
